parsed.rationale: Three production types — `HSBColor` in package `ColorPalette` and `AccentColor` plus `HSBOffset` in package `Wallpaper` — each carry an exact-duplicate initializer `init(hue:saturation:brightness:)`. None of the records carry any restraint flags (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false). The idiomatic Swift solution is to introduce a protocol `HSBInitializable` with a required `init(hue:saturation:brightness:)` and provide a default implementation in a protocol extension housed in `ColorPalette` (the lowest-level shared package), so that `Wallpaper` — which already depends on color primitives — can adopt it without a new dependency. This eliminates the three redundant bodies while preserving each type's distinct identity and domain semantics.
